title: Chocolate Martini

steps.instructionEnglish: Pour chocolate syrup onto a shallow plate. Dip rim of martini glasses into chocolate syrup to coat rims. Drizzle the inside of each glass with chocolate syrup.
steps.instructionGerman: Pour chocolate syrup onto a shallow plate. Dip rim of martini glasses into chocolate syrup to coat rims. Drizzle the inside of each glass with chocolate syrup.

steps.instructionEnglish: Combine Baileys, chocolate liqueur, and vodka in a large cocktail shaker. Fill with ice and shake until thoroughly chilled, about 20 seconds. Divide evenly between glasses. If using, top with shaved chocolate. Serve.
steps.instructionGerman: Combine Baileys, chocolate liqueur, and vodka in a large cocktail shaker. Fill with ice and shake until thoroughly chilled, about 20 seconds. Divide evenly between glasses. If using, top with shaved chocolate. Serve.

title: Easy Blackberry & Apple Jelly

steps.instructionEnglish: Soak and rinse the blackberries to get rid of any insects etc.
steps.instructionGerman: Soak and rinse the blackberries to get rid of any insects etc.

steps.instructionEnglish: Cut the apples into dice (don't peel or core).
steps.instructionGerman: Cut the apples into dice (don't peel or core).

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the fruits into a preserving pan or similar with enough water to barely cover.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the fruits into a preserving pan or similar with enough water to barely cover.

steps.instructionEnglish: Gradually bring to the boil and then simmer (uncovered).
steps.instructionGerman: Gradually bring to the boil and then simmer (uncovered).

steps.instructionEnglish: Strain the fruit and leave for at least 2 hrs or overnight covered with a tea towel. Do not push or squeeze the fruit.
steps.instructionGerman: Strain the fruit and leave for at least 2 hrs or overnight covered with a tea towel. Do not push or squeeze the fruit.
steps.tip: Do not push or squeeze the fruit, this will result in cloudy jelly.

steps.instructionEnglish: Place 2 - 3 saucers in the freezer for testing set.
steps.instructionGerman: Place 2 - 3 saucers in the freezer for testing set.

steps.instructionEnglish: Measure the juice and stir in 450g of granulated sugar for each 500 ml of juice.
steps.instructionGerman: Measure the juice and stir in 450g of granulated sugar for each 500 ml of juice.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat gently to dissolve the sugar, stirring constantly.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat gently to dissolve the sugar, stirring constantly.

steps.instructionEnglish: Remove any scum with a slotted metal spoon.
steps.instructionGerman: Remove any scum with a slotted metal spoon.

steps.instructionEnglish: Once the sugar has dissolved slowly bring the pan to the boil and once at a rolling boil, time for 20 minutes, then take off the heat.
steps.instructionGerman: Once the sugar has dissolved slowly bring the pan to the boil and once at a rolling boil, time for 20 minutes, then take off the heat.

steps.instructionEnglish: Test a few drops of jelly on a chilled saucer and pop in the fridge for a minute.
steps.instructionGerman: Test a few drops of jelly on a chilled saucer and pop in the fridge for a minute.

steps.instructionEnglish: Push your finger through the jelly and if it crinkles and forms a gel like clot which you can tip over then it's ready. If not carry on boiling for 2 minutes and repeat plate test until set achieved.
steps.instructionGerman: Push your finger through the jelly and if it crinkles and forms a gel like clot which you can tip over then it's ready. If not carry on boiling for 2 minutes and repeat plate test until set achieved.

steps.instructionEnglish: If there is any scum left then remove.
steps.instructionGerman: If there is any scum left then remove.

steps.instructionEnglish: Pot up into hot sterilised jars using a ladle and jam funnel if you have one and place lids on immediately.
steps.instructionGerman: Pot up into hot sterilised jars using a ladle and jam funnel if you have one and place lids on immediately.

steps.instructionEnglish: If the jelly tries to set before you get it in the jars, just set the pan over a low heat.
steps.instructionGerman: If the jelly tries to set before you get it in the jars, just set the pan over a low heat.

steps.instructionEnglish: Store in a cool, dark place and once opened keep in the fridge.
steps.instructionGerman: Store in a cool, dark place and once opened keep in the fridge.

notes: Sterilise jars by washing in hot soapy water, fill with boiling water, empty and then place in oven for 20 minutes at 140°C. To make a strainer, use a colander lined with a new pair of tights, clean net curtains, a tea towel or muslin.

title: Kimchi: A Beginner's Guide

ingredients.name: Korean-style red pepper flakes (gochugaru) or gochujang
ingredients.nameGerman: Korean-style red pepper flakes (gochugaru) or gochujang
ingredients.nameEnglish: Korean-style red pepper flakes (gochugaru) or gochujang

ingredients.name: Fish sauce (or vegan fish sauce, shrimp paste, miso paste, or soy sauce)
ingredients.nameGerman: Fish sauce (or vegan fish sauce, shrimp paste, miso paste, or soy sauce)
ingredients.nameEnglish: Fish sauce (or vegan fish sauce, shrimp paste, miso paste, or soy sauce)

steps.instructionEnglish: Salt the cabbage: Reserve 1-2 outer leaves. Cut remaining cabbage into 1-inch pieces. Toss with salt in a large bowl. Add enough cool water to cover and let stand at room temperature for 6-8 hours, stirring midway.
steps.instructionGerman: Salt the cabbage: Reserve 1-2 outer leaves. Cut remaining cabbage into 1-inch pieces. Toss with salt in a large bowl. Add enough cool water to cover and let stand at room temperature for 6-8 hours, stirring midway.

steps.instructionEnglish: Drain the cabbage, saving the brine. Rinse cabbage, drain, squeeze out excess water, and place in a bowl with daikon radish and scallions.
steps.instructionGerman: Drain the cabbage, saving the brine. Rinse cabbage, drain, squeeze out excess water, and place in a bowl with daikon radish and scallions.

steps.instructionEnglish: Make the paste: Process ginger, garlic, shallot, red pepper flakes, fish sauce, and sugar in a food processor until a thick paste forms. Add optional cooked rice powder if using.
steps.instructionGerman: Make the paste: Process ginger, garlic, shallot, red pepper flakes, fish sauce, and sugar in a food processor until a thick paste forms. Add optional cooked rice powder if using.

steps.instructionEnglish: Massage the paste into the cabbage and vegetable mixture until well coated.
steps.instructionGerman: Massage the paste into the cabbage and vegetable mixture until well coated.

steps.instructionEnglish: Pack into a jar, leaving 1-2 inches at the top. Add reserved brine to cover vegetables. Place reserved cabbage leaf on top to keep vegetables submerged.
steps.instructionGerman: Pack into a jar, leaving 1-2 inches at the top. Add reserved brine to cover vegetables. Place reserved cabbage leaf on top to keep vegetables submerged.

steps.instructionEnglish: Ferment: Cover loosely and place in a dark, cool spot (55-65F) for 3 days.
steps.instructionGerman: Ferment: Cover loosely and place in a dark, cool spot (55-65F) for 3 days.

steps.instructionEnglish: Check for fermentation bubbles. If bubbles are present, move to the refrigerator.
steps.instructionGerman: Check for fermentation bubbles. If bubbles are present, move to the refrigerator.

steps.instructionEnglish: Refrigerate for at least 2 weeks for full flavor development.
steps.instructionGerman: Refrigerate for at least 2 weeks for full flavor development.

notes: Total cook time includes 4 days of fermentation. Recipe is vegan-adaptable and gluten-free.

title: Pesto

steps.instructionEnglish: Blanch the basil leaves and refresh them in ice-cold water.
steps.instructionGerman: Blanch the basil leaves and refresh them in ice-cold water.

steps.instructionEnglish: Roast the pine kernels until golden.
steps.instructionGerman: Roast the pine kernels until golden.

steps.instructionEnglish: Combine the blanched basil, roasted pine kernels, garlic, grated Parmesan, salt, pepper, and olive oil in a food processor or mortar and pestle. Blend or crush until desired consistency is reached.
steps.instructionGerman: Combine the blanched basil, roasted pine kernels, garlic, grated Parmesan, salt, pepper, and olive oil in a food processor or mortar and pestle. Blend or crush until desired consistency is reached.

steps.instructionEnglish: Stir in optional chives if desired.
steps.instructionGerman: Stir in optional chives if desired.

notes: The card also mentions 'Rose petal Harissa (Belazu)' as a separate item or potential addition.

title: Herb Salt

steps.instructionEnglish: Pulse sage, rosemary, and thyme in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
steps.instructionGerman: Pulse sage, rosemary, and thyme in a food processor until coarsely chopped.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add salt, red pepper flakes, fennel seeds, and black pepper and pulse to blend.
steps.instructionGerman: Add salt, red pepper flakes, fennel seeds, and black pepper and pulse to blend.

notes: Salt can be made 2 months ahead. Store airtight at room temperature.

title: How To Make Fruit Leather

ingredients.name: Fruit and berries (washed, de-seeded, peels left on)
ingredients.nameGerman: Fruit and berries (washed, de-seeded, peels left on)
ingredients.nameEnglish: Fruit and berries (washed, de-seeded, peels left on)

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the fruit in a pot. If using ground spices, add them too. Add about 1/4 cup of water (or just enough to keep the bottom from scorching). Cover and stew the fruit for 5-10 minutes or until softened.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the fruit in a pot. If using ground spices, add them too. Add about 1/4 cup of water (or just enough to keep the bottom from scorching). Cover and stew the fruit for 5-10 minutes or until softened.
steps.tip: If the fruit is very juicy like plums or peaches, use minimal water.

steps.instructionEnglish: Puree the fruit until smooth using a countertop blender or immersion blender. Pour the pureed fruit onto lined cookie sheets (silicone or parchment paper) and spread to a thickness of about 1/4 inch or slightly less.
steps.instructionGerman: Puree the fruit until smooth using a countertop blender or immersion blender. Pour the pureed fruit onto lined cookie sheets (silicone or parchment paper) and spread to a thickness of about 1/4 inch or slightly less.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the oven to 140°F. Bake for 8-12 hours until the surface is smooth and no longer sticky. You can use a convection setting to speed up the process.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the oven to 140°F. Bake for 8-12 hours until the surface is smooth and no longer sticky. You can use a convection setting to speed up the process.
steps.tip: Can also be done in a food dehydrator.

steps.instructionEnglish: Slice the fruit leather into strips. If using parchment paper, remove while slightly warm to prevent sticking.
steps.instructionGerman: Slice the fruit leather into strips. If using parchment paper, remove while slightly warm to prevent sticking.

steps.instructionEnglish: To store, roll the strips in plastic wrap and place in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer.
steps.instructionGerman: To store, roll the strips in plastic wrap and place in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer.

notes: Experiment with fun flavor combinations like apple-pear, apple-cinnamon, peach-strawberry, or plum-banana.

title: Home-made damson cheese

steps.instructionEnglish: Put the damsons in a large preserving pan, add a couple of tablespoons of water and bring slowly to a simmer, stirring as the fruit begins to release its juices. Leave to simmer until completely soft.
steps.instructionGerman: Put the damsons in a large preserving pan, add a couple of tablespoons of water and bring slowly to a simmer, stirring as the fruit begins to release its juices. Leave to simmer until completely soft.

steps.instructionEnglish: Tip the contents of the pan into a sieve and rub it through to remove the stones and skin, leaving you with a smooth damson purée.
steps.instructionGerman: Tip the contents of the pan into a sieve and rub it through to remove the stones and skin, leaving you with a smooth damson purée.

steps.instructionEnglish: Measure the purée by volume. For every 500ml, add 350g sugar.
steps.instructionGerman: Measure the purée by volume. For every 500ml, add 350g sugar.

steps.instructionEnglish: Combine in a large, heavy-based pan bringing it to a simmer over a low heat. Stir to dissolve the sugar, then cook gently, stirring regularly so it doesn't catch, until reduced to a thick purée. It's ready when you drag the spoon across the bottom of the pan and the base stays clearly visible for a second or two.
steps.instructionGerman: Combine in a large, heavy-based pan bringing it to a simmer over a low heat. Stir to dissolve the sugar, then cook gently, stirring regularly so it doesn't catch, until reduced to a thick purée. It's ready when you drag the spoon across the bottom of the pan and the base stays clearly visible for a second or two.
steps.tip: This can take up to an hour of gentle, popping simmering and stirring.

steps.instructionEnglish: Pour the 'cheese' into very lightly-oiled, shallow containers and leave to cool and set. It will keep almost indefinitely in the fridge. Serve in slices with bread and cheese.
steps.instructionGerman: Pour the 'cheese' into very lightly-oiled, shallow containers and leave to cool and set. It will keep almost indefinitely in the fridge. Serve in slices with bread and cheese.

notes: Recipe by Hugh Fearley Whittingstall. Printed from H is for Home.

title: Vanilla Blackberry Jam (Variation)

steps.instructionEnglish: Add blackberries, sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla extract to a heavy-bottomed saucepan. Place over medium heat. Place a small plate in the freezer.
steps.instructionGerman: Add blackberries, sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla extract to a heavy-bottomed saucepan. Place over medium heat. Place a small plate in the freezer.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the blackberries until they begin to break down, and simmer into liquid. Bring the heat to medium-low.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the blackberries until they begin to break down, and simmer into liquid. Bring the heat to medium-low.

steps.instructionEnglish: Continue to cook, stirring almost constantly, until the blackberries are completely broken down, and the mixture is gelled.
steps.instructionGerman: Continue to cook, stirring almost constantly, until the blackberries are completely broken down, and the mixture is gelled.

steps.instructionEnglish: To test readiness, take the plate from the freezer, and spoon a small amount of the jam onto the plate. Jam should set up and be loose, but not runny. Run a spoon through the jam; if the line stays intact, the jam is gelled.
steps.instructionGerman: To test readiness, take the plate from the freezer, and spoon a small amount of the jam onto the plate. Jam should set up and be loose, but not runny. Run a spoon through the jam; if the line stays intact, the jam is gelled.

steps.instructionEnglish: Remove the jam from the heat, and let cool completely. Stir in the lemon zest, and add the jam to jars to store.
steps.instructionGerman: Remove the jam from the heat, and let cool completely. Stir in the lemon zest, and add the jam to jars to store.

notes: Handwritten notes on the recipe card indicate 700g for the blackberries and 200g for the sugar.

title: The best blackberry jam with bay and vanilla

ingredients.name: Blackberry and apple gin or normal gin
ingredients.nameGerman: Blackberry and apple gin or normal gin
ingredients.nameEnglish: Blackberry and apple gin or normal gin

steps.instructionEnglish: Simmer the blackberries, lemon juice, apple, bay leaf, and 50ml of water in a pan until all the fruit is tender.
steps.instructionGerman: Simmer the blackberries, lemon juice, apple, bay leaf, and 50ml of water in a pan until all the fruit is tender.

steps.instructionEnglish: Mash fruit with a potato masher (you can press half of it, all of it or none of it through a sieve for smooth texture).
steps.instructionGerman: Mash fruit with a potato masher (you can press half of it, all of it or none of it through a sieve for smooth texture).

steps.instructionEnglish: Add the vanilla extract, salt, and sugar. Allow sugar to dissolve completely, then bring to boil for about 5 minutes until it reaches 105C (the setting point).
steps.instructionGerman: Add the vanilla extract, salt, and sugar. Allow sugar to dissolve completely, then bring to boil for about 5 minutes until it reaches 105C (the setting point).

steps.instructionEnglish: Carefully ladle into sterilised jars.
steps.instructionGerman: Carefully ladle into sterilised jars.

steps.instructionEnglish: Stir in 1 tsp of gin in each jar.
steps.instructionGerman: Stir in 1 tsp of gin in each jar.

notes: Recipe by Karon Grieve. Calories shown for total amount of jam made.

title: Damson Chutney (Variation)

ingredients.name: Bramley apples, peeled, cored, and cut into small cubes
ingredients.nameGerman: Bramley apples, peeled, cored, and cut into small cubes
ingredients.nameEnglish: Bramley apples, peeled, cored, and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Green chilli, washed and finely chopped
ingredients.nameGerman: Green chilli, washed and finely chopped
ingredients.nameEnglish: Green chilli, washed and finely chopped

steps.instructionEnglish: Place all the ingredients in a large heavy bottomed saucepan.
steps.instructionGerman: Place all the ingredients in a large heavy bottomed saucepan.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the contents slowly until boiling point is reached.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the contents slowly until boiling point is reached.

steps.instructionEnglish: Turn the heat down until a consistent slow simmering point is reached.
steps.instructionGerman: Turn the heat down until a consistent slow simmering point is reached.

steps.instructionEnglish: Cook for at least 2 hours but no more than 5. Check on it every 30 minutes and stir occasionally.
steps.instructionGerman: Cook for at least 2 hours but no more than 5. Check on it every 30 minutes and stir occasionally.

steps.instructionEnglish: Towards the end of cooking time stir the chutney more to ensure that nothing sticks and burns at the bottom. It will thicken when it cools.
steps.instructionGerman: Towards the end of cooking time stir the chutney more to ensure that nothing sticks and burns at the bottom. It will thicken when it cools.

steps.instructionEnglish: Pour into sterilised containers and seal with airtight lids. Enjoy as part of a cheeseboard!
steps.instructionGerman: Pour into sterilised containers and seal with airtight lids. Enjoy as part of a cheeseboard!

notes: Yields 6 x 370ml jars and 3 x 185ml jars. You can use a cherry pitter to stone the damsons.

title: Damson Hoisin Sauce

ingredients.name: onions (red or white, or a mix)
ingredients.nameGerman: onions (red or white, or a mix)
ingredients.nameEnglish: onions (red or white, or a mix)

ingredients.name: chilies (adjust to taste, or add cayenne for extra heat)
ingredients.nameGerman: chilies (adjust to taste, or add cayenne for extra heat)
ingredients.nameEnglish: chilies (adjust to taste, or add cayenne for extra heat)

steps.instructionEnglish: Prepare Ingredients: Roughly chop the onions, garlic, ginger, and chilies. (Tip: Use a teaspoon to peel garlic and ginger easily.)
steps.instructionGerman: Prepare Ingredients: Roughly chop the onions, garlic, ginger, and chilies. (Tip: Use a teaspoon to peel garlic and ginger easily.)
steps.tip: Use a teaspoon to peel garlic and ginger easily.

steps.instructionEnglish: Combine Ingredients: Place all ingredients (damsons, onions, garlic, ginger, chilies, star anise, sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce) in a large, heavy saucepan or jam pan.
steps.instructionGerman: Combine Ingredients: Place all ingredients (damsons, onions, garlic, ginger, chilies, star anise, sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce) in a large, heavy saucepan or jam pan.

steps.instructionEnglish: Cook the Mixture: Heat on low, stirring occasionally, until the mixture simmers and the damsons soften. Squash any whole damsons to release their flesh.
steps.instructionGerman: Cook the Mixture: Heat on low, stirring occasionally, until the mixture simmers and the damsons soften. Squash any whole damsons to release their flesh.

steps.instructionEnglish: Remove Stones: After 15-20 minutes, carefully pick out the damson stones as they float free. Check multiple times to ensure all stones are removed.
steps.instructionGerman: Remove Stones: After 15-20 minutes, carefully pick out the damson stones as they float free. Check multiple times to ensure all stones are removed.

steps.instructionEnglish: Blend the Sauce: Remove star anise (optional) and blend the mixture with a stick blender until smooth. Stop immediately if you hear a stone and remove it.
steps.instructionGerman: Blend the Sauce: Remove star anise (optional) and blend the mixture with a stick blender until smooth. Stop immediately if you hear a stone and remove it.

steps.instructionEnglish: Reduce and Sieve: Return the sauce to the stove and simmer until it reaches a thick, paintable consistency. If you suspect stone fragments, pass the sauce through a sieve.
steps.instructionGerman: Reduce and Sieve: Return the sauce to the stove and simmer until it reaches a thick, paintable consistency. If you suspect stone fragments, pass the sauce through a sieve.

steps.instructionEnglish: Sterilize Jars: Wash jars in hot, soapy water and sterilize in a low oven.
steps.instructionGerman: Sterilize Jars: Wash jars in hot, soapy water and sterilize in a low oven.

steps.instructionEnglish: Jar the Sauce: Pour the hot sauce into sterilized jars, seal, and let cool. Allow the sauce to mature for 2-3 weeks for best flavor.
steps.instructionGerman: Jar the Sauce: Pour the hot sauce into sterilized jars, seal, and let cool. Allow the sauce to mature for 2-3 weeks for best flavor.

notes: The sauce is versatile for brushing on duck, chicken, or ribs, or as a base for stews. Adjust chili heat to your preference; milder chilies can be used for a less spicy sauce.

title: Damson Ketchup Recipe

steps.instructionEnglish: Pour the olive oil into a large saucepan and add the onions, star anise, cinnamon, cloves and bay leaf. Season with a pinch of salt and cook until the onions are soft and translucent.
steps.instructionGerman: Pour the olive oil into a large saucepan and add the onions, star anise, cinnamon, cloves and bay leaf. Season with a pinch of salt and cook until the onions are soft and translucent.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add the damsons with the cooked beetroot, vinegar, sugar and water and simmer until the damsons have broken down and released their juices.
steps.instructionGerman: Add the damsons with the cooked beetroot, vinegar, sugar and water and simmer until the damsons have broken down and released their juices.

steps.instructionEnglish: Transfer the contents of the pan (discarding the whole spices and bay leaf, unless you want a very spiced flavour) to a blender and blitz for a few minutes until you're left with a smooth purple ketchup.
steps.instructionGerman: Transfer the contents of the pan (discarding the whole spices and bay leaf, unless you want a very spiced flavour) to a blender and blitz for a few minutes until you're left with a smooth purple ketchup.

steps.instructionEnglish: Taste and season with salt. Damsons can vary in their sourness so you may want to adjust sugar levels or add a splash more water until you are happy with the taste.
steps.instructionGerman: Taste and season with salt. Damsons can vary in their sourness so you may want to adjust sugar levels or add a splash more water until you are happy with the taste.

steps.instructionEnglish: Leave to cool then store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
steps.instructionGerman: Leave to cool then store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

notes: Recipe by GBC Kitchen (Great British Chefs).

title: Cherry Tomato Relish

ingredients.name: cherry tomatoes, halved (or large tomatoes, chopped)
ingredients.nameGerman: cherry tomatoes, halved (or large tomatoes, chopped)
ingredients.nameEnglish: cherry tomatoes, halved (or large tomatoes, chopped)

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook until softened.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook until softened.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add the garlic and a pinch of sea salt, cooking until fragrant.
steps.instructionGerman: Add the garlic and a pinch of sea salt, cooking until fragrant.

steps.instructionEnglish: Stir in the cherry tomatoes, caster sugar, and red wine vinegar.
steps.instructionGerman: Stir in the cherry tomatoes, caster sugar, and red wine vinegar.

steps.instructionEnglish: Simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have broken down and the liquid has reduced to a relish consistency.
steps.instructionGerman: Simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have broken down and the liquid has reduced to a relish consistency.

steps.instructionEnglish: Season with additional sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste before cooling and storing.
steps.instructionGerman: Season with additional sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste before cooling and storing.

title: Spicy plum & apple chutney

steps.instructionEnglish: Sterilise the jars: run them with the lids and any rubber seals through the hottest cycle of your dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher, give the jars a good wash, then heat them in the oven at 150C/130C fan/gas 2 for 30 mins. Don't have seals - boil them in a pan of water for 10 mins.
steps.instructionGerman: Sterilise the jars: run them with the lids and any rubber seals through the hottest cycle of your dishwasher. If you don't have a dishwasher, give the jars a good wash, then heat them in the oven at 150C/130C fan/gas 2 for 30 mins. Don't have seals - boil them in a pan of water for 10 mins.

steps.instructionEnglish: Prepare the ingredients: peel the garlic cloves and cut into slivers. Peel and thinly shred the ginger. Halve, peel and thinly slice the onions, then put them in a large, wide saucepan or a preserving pan with the garlic and ginger. Peel, core and chop the apples, then add to the pan with the spices, vinegar and salt.
steps.instructionGerman: Prepare the ingredients: peel the garlic cloves and cut into slivers. Peel and thinly shred the ginger. Halve, peel and thinly slice the onions, then put them in a large, wide saucepan or a preserving pan with the garlic and ginger. Peel, core and chop the apples, then add to the pan with the spices, vinegar and salt.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bring the pan to the boil over a gentle heat, give everything a good stir, then turn down the heat and cover the pan. Simmer until the apples are cooked and pulpy.
steps.instructionGerman: Bring the pan to the boil over a gentle heat, give everything a good stir, then turn down the heat and cover the pan. Simmer until the apples are cooked and pulpy.
steps.tip: If you don't have a lid use foil.

steps.instructionEnglish: While the apples are simmering, stone and quarter the plums, then add them to the cooked apples with the sugar. Stir well and leave to bubble away, uncovered, until the plums are cooked but still retain some of their shape. Ladle into the sterilised jars, seal and label.
steps.instructionGerman: While the apples are simmering, stone and quarter the plums, then add them to the cooked apples with the sugar. Stir well and leave to bubble away, uncovered, until the plums are cooked but still retain some of their shape. Ladle into the sterilised jars, seal and label.

steps.instructionEnglish: This chutney is best kept for about a month before eating as the vinegar needs a bit of time to mellow. If you don't want the flavour of the spices to develop any more, then take out the cinnamon and star anise before potting.
steps.instructionGerman: This chutney is best kept for about a month before eating as the vinegar needs a bit of time to mellow. If you don't want the flavour of the spices to develop any more, then take out the cinnamon and star anise before potting.
steps.tip: It will keep for 1 year in a cool place but once opened store in the fridge and use within a month.

notes: Recipe by Sara Buenfeld. The cook time is the sum of the simmering stages (30 mins + 40 mins).

title: Spiced Crab Apple Jelly with Scotch Whisky (Variation)

steps.instructionEnglish: Place apples plus spices in a pan with just enough water to cover the fruit. Simmer for about 15 minutes till fruit is tender and press with a potato masher.
steps.instructionGerman: Place apples plus spices in a pan with just enough water to cover the fruit. Simmer for about 15 minutes till fruit is tender and press with a potato masher.

steps.instructionEnglish: Let the fruit pulp drain through a jelly bag or muslin lined sieve overnight. Do NOT squeeze the bag.
steps.instructionGerman: Let the fruit pulp drain through a jelly bag or muslin lined sieve overnight. Do NOT squeeze the bag.
steps.tip: Do not squeeze the bag to ensure clear jelly.

steps.instructionEnglish: Measure the resulting juice (the author notes 400ml juice used 300g sugar; ratio is 450g sugar for every 600ml juice).
steps.instructionGerman: Measure the resulting juice (the author notes 400ml juice used 300g sugar; ratio is 450g sugar for every 600ml juice).

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves, then boil rapidly until it reaches the 105°C setting point.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves, then boil rapidly until it reaches the 105°C setting point.

steps.instructionEnglish: Spoon into sterilised jars, add 1 tsp whisky to each jar, stir through, and pop on the lids.
steps.instructionGerman: Spoon into sterilised jars, add 1 tsp whisky to each jar, stir through, and pop on the lids.

notes: Serve with pate or a cheeseboard as well as on toast. Use as a glaze for roasts. Crab apple jelly will keep for up to a year in a cool cupboard; once opened store in the fridge and use within a month. Handwritten notes suggest a ratio of 450g sugar per 600ml juice for a very sweet result.

title: The One Day Bake Sourdough

steps.instructionEnglish: 10:00pm Feed Starter - remove most of the starter leaving at least 2 Tbsp, then feed your starter with flour and ice cold water to slow down the activation.
steps.instructionGerman: 10:00pm Feed Starter - remove most of the starter leaving at least 2 Tbsp, then feed your starter with flour and ice cold water to slow down the activation.
steps.tip: The ice water will give you an extra 2-4 hours of activation time.

steps.instructionEnglish: 10:00pm Autolyse - mix flour and water together to form shaggy mass.
steps.instructionGerman: 10:00pm Autolyse - mix flour and water together to form shaggy mass.

steps.instructionEnglish: 7:00am - Add Starter and Salt to the Dough - once the starter is fully activated, incorporate the starter and salt into the dough with the stretch and fold technique.
steps.instructionGerman: 7:00am - Add Starter and Salt to the Dough - once the starter is fully activated, incorporate the starter and salt into the dough with the stretch and fold technique.

steps.instructionEnglish: 7:30am - Stretch and Fold - perform a stretch and fold every 30 minutes for the next 2-2.5 hours until you feel the dough has developed a nice gluten structure.
steps.instructionGerman: 7:30am - Stretch and Fold - perform a stretch and fold every 30 minutes for the next 2-2.5 hours until you feel the dough has developed a nice gluten structure.

steps.instructionEnglish: 9:30am - Bulk Rise - Let the dough sit for the next few hours until it has risen by 30-50%.
steps.instructionGerman: 9:30am - Bulk Rise - Let the dough sit for the next few hours until it has risen by 30-50%.
steps.tip: The bulk rise can take anywhere from 2-6 hours depending on variables like temperature.

steps.instructionEnglish: 2:00pm - Pre Shape - once your satisfied with your bulk rise, remove the dough onto a floured surface and pre shape your loaves.
steps.instructionGerman: 2:00pm - Pre Shape - once your satisfied with your bulk rise, remove the dough onto a floured surface and pre shape your loaves.

steps.instructionEnglish: 2:30pm - Bench Rest - let the reshaped loaves bench rest.
steps.instructionGerman: 2:30pm - Bench Rest - let the reshaped loaves bench rest.

steps.instructionGerman: Divide the batter equally between the prepared pans. Tap the bottoms of the pans against the counter several times to release any air bubbles.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until a cake tester or toothpick comes out clean. It's normal for the cake to look slightly spongy on top. title: Baileys Tiramisu Trifle

To one, add the 50g chopped dark chocolate and sea salt, whisking until the chocolate has melted. To the second, add the mascarpone and Baileys, whisking until evenly combined. Press a sheet of clingfilm onto the surface of the custards to stop skins forming and chill for a few hours.

steps.instructionEnglish: Whisk 80ml water and cornstarch together. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and swirl. Line up the dumplings in the pan, starting in the centre and spiralling outwards. Fry for 2 minutes. Stir the slurry and pour over the pan, ensuring all spaces between dumplings are covered. steps.instructionGerman: Whisk 80ml water and cornstarch together. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and swirl. title: The best roast turkey - Christmas or any time

ingredients.name: higher-welfare pancetta or thinly sliced streaky bacon
ingredients.nameGerman: higher-welfare pancetta or thinly sliced streaky bacon
ingredients.nameEnglish: higher-welfare pancetta or thinly sliced streaky bacon

steps.instructionEnglish: Preheat the oven to maximum. Heat a saucepan until medium hot and add a splash of olive oil. Pick the sage leaves and add to the pan with 6 of the pancetta or bacon strips.
steps.instructionGerman: Preheat the oven to maximum. Heat a saucepan until medium hot and add a splash of olive oil. Pick the sage leaves and add to the pan with 6 of the pancetta or bacon strips.

steps.instructionEnglish: Peel and chop 2 garlic cloves and 1 onion. Trim and chop the celery and add to the pan with the garlic and onion. Fry everything gently until soft and golden brown. Take the pan off the heat, add the breadcrumbs and, while the mix is cooling down, roughly chop the apricots and stir them in.
steps.instructionGerman: Peel and chop 2 garlic cloves and 1 onion. Trim and chop the celery and add to the pan with the garlic and onion. Fry everything gently until soft and golden brown. Take the pan off the heat, add the breadcrumbs and, while the mix is cooling down, roughly chop the apricots and stir them in.

steps.instructionEnglish: When the stuffing has cooled down, add the pork, lemon zest, nutmeg, egg and lots of sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, and mix everything together well. Slice the remaining strips of pancetta or bacon in half and peel and slice 1 peeled garlic clove into thin slivers. Place a rosemary sprig and a garlic sliver on one end of a halved strip of pancetta and roll it up tightly. Repeat with the other pieces of pancetta until you have 12 little rolls.
steps.instructionGerman: When the stuffing has cooled down, add the pork, lemon zest, nutmeg, egg and lots of sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, and mix everything together well. Slice the remaining strips of pancetta or bacon in half and peel and slice 1 peeled garlic clove into thin slivers. Place a rosemary sprig and a garlic sliver on one end of a halved strip of pancetta and roll it up tightly. Repeat with the other pieces of pancetta until you have 12 little rolls.

steps.instructionEnglish: Stab the thighs and drumsticks of the turkey in 6 places on each side. Push a little pancetta roll into each hole until it just peeps out.
steps.instructionGerman: Stab the thighs and drumsticks of the turkey in 6 places on each side. Push a little pancetta roll into each hole until it just peeps out.

steps.instructionEnglish: Peel the remaining onions and chop in half, and peel and thickly slice the carrots.
steps.instructionGerman: Peel the remaining onions and chop in half, and peel and thickly slice the carrots.

steps.instructionEnglish: Give your turkey a good wipe, inside and out, with kitchen paper, and place it on a board, with the neck end towards you. Find the edge of the skin that's covering the turkey's breasts and gently peel it back. Work your fingers and then your hand under the skin, freeing it from the meat.
steps.instructionGerman: Give your turkey a good wipe, inside and out, with kitchen paper, and place it on a board, with the neck end towards you. Find the edge of the skin that's covering the turkey's breasts and gently peel it back. Work your fingers and then your hand under the skin, freeing it from the meat.

steps.instructionEnglish: Lift the loose skin at the neck end and spoon the stuffing between the skin and the breast, tucking the flap of skin underneath to stop anything leaking out. Pop the orange in the microwave for 30 seconds to warm it up and stuff it into the cavity.
steps.instructionGerman: Lift the loose skin at the neck end and spoon the stuffing between the skin and the breast, tucking the flap of skin underneath to stop anything leaking out. Pop the orange in the microwave for 30 seconds to warm it up and stuff it into the cavity.

steps.instructionEnglish: Weigh the stuffed turkey and calculate the cooking time (about 20 minutes per 500g/1lb 2oz).
steps.instructionGerman: Weigh the stuffed turkey and calculate the cooking time (about 20 minutes per 500g/1lb 2oz).

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the bird on a large roasting tray, rub it all over with olive oil and season well. Surround with the chopped carrots, onions and remaining cloves of garlic, cover with tin foil and place in the preheated oven. Turn the heat down right away to 180°C/350°F/gas 4 and roast for the calculated time, or until the juices run clear from the thigh if you pierce it with a knife or a skewer. Remove the tin foil for the last 45 minutes to brown the bird.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the bird on a large roasting tray, rub it all over with olive oil and season well. Surround with the chopped carrots, onions and remaining cloves of garlic, cover with tin foil and place in the preheated oven. Turn the heat down right away to 180°C/350°F/gas 4 and roast for the calculated time, or until the juices run clear from the thigh if you pierce it with a knife or a skewer. Remove the tin foil for the last 45 minutes to brown the bird.

steps.instructionEnglish: Carefully lift the turkey out of the tray and rest on a board covered loosely with foil for at least 1 hour, preferably 2 hours for bigger birds.
steps.instructionGerman: Carefully lift the turkey out of the tray and rest on a board covered loosely with foil for at least 1 hour, preferably 2 hours for bigger birds.

steps.instructionEnglish: When the resting time's nearly up, skim off the surface fat from the roasting tray and add the flour and stock. Place the tray on the hob and bring to the boil on a high heat. When the gravy starts to thicken, strain it into a bowl.
steps.instructionGerman: When the resting time's nearly up, skim off the surface fat from the roasting tray and add the flour and stock. Place the tray on the hob and bring to the boil on a high heat. When the gravy starts to thicken, strain it into a bowl.

steps.instructionEnglish: Carve your turkey, serve with the gravy and dig in!
steps.instructionGerman: Carve your turkey, serve with the gravy and dig in!

notes: Cooking time is estimated based on a 4.5kg bird (approx 180 mins) plus 45 minutes browning, totaling 220 minutes.

steps.instructionGerman: Cook the spaetzle according to the instructions on the packet.

title: Sesame Prawn Toast

ingredients.name: Neutral flavoured vegetable oil (vegetable, canola, sunflower, or peanut)
ingredients.nameGerman: Neutral flavoured vegetable oil (vegetable, canola, sunflower, or peanut)
ingredients.nameEnglish: Neutral flavoured vegetable oil (vegetable, canola, sunflower, or peanut)

ingredients.name: Chilli flakes or Japanese Shichimi chilli
ingredients.nameGerman: Chilli flakes or Japanese Shichimi chilli
ingredients.nameEnglish: Chilli flakes or Japanese Shichimi chilli

steps.instructionEnglish: To make the prawn fillings, add the prawns, egg white, spring onions, garlic, and seasoning ingredients in the food processor. Blend it into a smooth paste.
steps.instructionGerman: To make the prawn fillings, add the prawns, egg white, spring onions, garlic, and seasoning ingredients in the food processor. Blend it into a smooth paste.

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the sesame seeds in the plate and set aside.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the sesame seeds in the plate and set aside.

steps.instructionEnglish: Cut the bread crust out and cut in the middle into triangle shapes.
steps.instructionGerman: Cut the bread crust out and cut in the middle into triangle shapes.

steps.instructionEnglish: Place about 1 tablespoon size fillings on the bread, spread the fillings evenly on the bread by using a butter knife.
steps.instructionGerman: Place about 1 tablespoon size fillings on the bread, spread the fillings evenly on the bread by using a butter knife.

steps.instructionEnglish: Dip the filling side down gently in the sesame seeds until the fillings are coated with sesame seeds evenly. Repeat process to remaining bread slices and set aside. Gently toss the excess sesame seeds out before frying.
steps.instructionGerman: Dip the filling side down gently in the sesame seeds until the fillings are coated with sesame seeds evenly. Repeat process to remaining bread slices and set aside. Gently toss the excess sesame seeds out before frying.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the oil into medium heat about 320°F, test with a wooden chopstick or a piece of bread, once the oil bubbles start sizzling steadily it's ready to fry.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the oil into medium heat about 320°F, test with a wooden chopstick or a piece of bread, once the oil bubbles start sizzling steadily it's ready to fry.

steps.instructionEnglish: Fry the filling side down until crispy and turn sides and fry until golden brown.
steps.instructionGerman: Fry the filling side down until crispy and turn sides and fry until golden brown.

steps.instructionEnglish: Remove from pan and place it on the paper towel to soak the excess oil.
steps.instructionGerman: Remove from pan and place it on the paper towel to soak the excess oil.

steps.instructionEnglish: Garnish with chopped spring onions. Serve immediately with spicy mayo, sweet chilli sauce or any of your favourite dipping sauce.
steps.instructionGerman: Garnish with chopped spring onions. Serve immediately with spicy mayo, sweet chilli sauce or any of your favourite dipping sauce.

steps.instructionEnglish: To make the spicy mayo, mix the mayonnaise, chilli sauce, chilli flakes and lime juice in a small bowl.
steps.instructionGerman: To make the spicy mayo, mix the mayonnaise, chilli sauce, chilli flakes and lime juice in a small bowl.

notes: Bread: You can use white, sourdough, or wholemeal sandwich bread. Any dry stale bread or baguettes are great to make prawn toast as they don't absorb the oil much. Baking/ Air Frying Option: you can bake in an oven or in an air fryer. Place the toast filling side up on the baking tray. Spray or brush a bit of oil on the toast and bake in 400° F preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until crispy. Turn sides in halfway and bake until crispy golden brown. Pan Fry Option: If you wish to pan fry it, use a large flat pan or skillet, drizzle oil to slightly cover the pan, and fry the prawn side down first. Once it is crisp and golden, flip and fry another side.

title: Damson Chutney

ingredients.name: Wood avens root, thoroughly cleaned (or 1 teaspoon whole cloves)
ingredients.nameGerman: Wood avens root, thoroughly cleaned (or 1 teaspoon whole cloves)
ingredients.nameEnglish: Wood avens root, thoroughly cleaned (or 1 teaspoon whole cloves)

steps.instructionEnglish: Wash the damsons and stone them. The easiest way to do this is to cut around the fruit, then pick or lever out the stone. Core the apples (leaving the peel on) and finely chop them. Finely chop the onions and the garlic.
steps.instructionGerman: Wash the damsons and stone them. The easiest way to do this is to cut around the fruit, then pick or lever out the stone. Core the apples (leaving the peel on) and finely chop them. Finely chop the onions and the garlic.

steps.instructionEnglish: Put the prepared fruit, onions, garlic, sultanas, sugar, ground ginger, salt and vinegar into a large pan. Take a small piece of muslin and wrap the allspice, cinnamon stick and wood avens root (or cloves). Gather the edges of the muslin together to form a bag and tie securely with string. Add the bag of spices to the pan, pushing it down into the vinegar, and set the pan over a medium heat.
steps.instructionGerman: Put the prepared fruit, onions, garlic, sultanas, sugar, ground ginger, salt and vinegar into a large pan. Take a small piece of muslin and wrap the allspice, cinnamon stick and wood avens root (or cloves). Gather the edges of the muslin together to form a bag and tie securely with string. Add the bag of spices to the pan, pushing it down into the vinegar, and set the pan over a medium heat.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bring the contents of the pan to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently for about 3 hours, stirring occasionally especially towards the end of the cooking time to stop the chutney catching on the bottom of the pan.
steps.instructionGerman: Bring the contents of the pan to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently for about 3 hours, stirring occasionally especially towards the end of the cooking time to stop the chutney catching on the bottom of the pan.

steps.instructionEnglish: When almost all the vinegar has evaporated and the mixture is thickened, draw your wooden spoon through the centre of the pan. If the chutney is ready, the path of the spoon will leave a channel for a few seconds before the liquid flows in again.
steps.instructionGerman: When almost all the vinegar has evaporated and the mixture is thickened, draw your wooden spoon through the centre of the pan. If the chutney is ready, the path of the spoon will leave a channel for a few seconds before the liquid flows in again.

steps.instructionEnglish: Remove and discard the bag of spices, then ladle the chutney while it's still warm into sterilised jars, leaving a small gap at the top. Fasten the lids and leave to cool, then store the chutney in a cool dark place for at least 3 months before eating, to allow the flavours to meld and deepen.
steps.instructionGerman: Remove and discard the bag of spices, then ladle the chutney while it's still warm into sterilised jars, leaving a small gap at the top. Fasten the lids and leave to cool, then store the chutney in a cool dark place for at least 3 months before eating, to allow the flavours to meld and deepen.

steps.instructionEnglish: Soak the glass noodles in warm water for 4-5 minutes until tender. Drain the water out and gently squeeze the noodles to remove the excess water. Cut the noodle strands into 2" pieces and set it aside.
steps.instructionGerman: Soak the glass noodles in warm water for 4-5 minutes until tender. Drain the water out and gently squeeze the noodles to remove the excess water. Cut the noodle strands into 2" pieces and set it aside.

steps.instructionEnglish: Heat the large wok/pan over medium high heat, drizzle 2 tablespoon of vegetable oil, add the chopped garlic and stir for few seconds.
steps.instructionGerman: Heat the large wok/pan over medium high heat, drizzle 2 tablespoon of vegetable oil, add the chopped garlic and stir for few seconds.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add the chicken mince and stir for few seconds, then follow with the finely chopped coriander stems and continue cook for another 1-2 minutes.
steps.instructionGerman: Add the chicken mince and stir for few seconds, then follow with the finely chopped coriander stems and continue cook for another 1-2 minutes.

steps.instructionEnglish: Follow with the shredded carrots, stir for few seconds and add the shredded cabbage.
steps.instructionGerman: Follow with the shredded carrots, stir for few seconds and add the shredded cabbage.

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the glass noodles in, add fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar. Continue stir fry for another 2-3 minutes until the vegetables are wilted and noodles are soft and tender.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the glass noodles in, add fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar. Continue stir fry for another 2-3 minutes until the vegetables are wilted and noodles are soft and tender.

steps.instructionEnglish: Transfer to large tray or plate and let it completely cool down. If there is any liquid from vegetables left in the fillings, place the fillings over the strainer and drain all the liquid out.
steps.instructionGerman: Transfer to large tray or plate and let it completely cool down. If there is any liquid from vegetables left in the fillings, place the fillings over the strainer and drain all the liquid out.

steps.instructionEnglish: To wrap the spring rolls, scoop 2-3 tablespoon of fillings on one side of the wrapper. Fold away from your side like an envelope. Seal it up with the plain flour and water mixture glue. Repeat the process to all rolls until the fillings runs out.
steps.instructionGerman: To wrap the spring rolls, scoop 2-3 tablespoon of fillings on one side of the wrapper. Fold away from your side like an envelope. Seal it up with the plain flour and water mixture glue. Repeat the process to all rolls until the fillings runs out.

steps.instructionGerman: Deep Frying: Heat the vegetable oil or neutral flavour oil into high heat about 350°F. Deep fry the spring rolls for 5-6 minutes, or until crispy golden brown.

steps.instructionEnglish: Baking Option: Place the spring rolls on the wire rack, over the baking tray. Brush or spray generous amount of vegetable oil on both sides. Pre-heat the oven or air-fryer about 400°F, bake until crispy golden about 18-20 minutes. Turn sides halfway through.
steps.instructionGerman: Baking Option: Place the spring rolls on the wire rack, over the baking tray. Brush or spray generous amount of vegetable oil on both sides. Pre-heat the oven or air-fryer about 400°F, bake until crispy golden about 18-20 minutes. Turn sides halfway through.

title: How to Make Cabbage Kimchi

ingredients.name: Iodine-free sea salt or kosher salt
ingredients.nameGerman: Iodine-free sea salt or kosher salt
ingredients.nameEnglish: Iodine-free sea salt or kosher salt

ingredients.name: Fish sauce or salted shrimp paste, or water
ingredients.nameGerman: Fish sauce or salted shrimp paste, or water
ingredients.nameEnglish: Fish sauce or salted shrimp paste, or water

ingredients.name: Korean radish or daikon radish, peeled and cut into matchsticks
ingredients.nameGerman: Korean radish or daikon radish, peeled and cut into matchsticks
ingredients.nameEnglish: Korean radish or daikon radish, peeled and cut into matchsticks

ingredients.name: Scallions, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.nameGerman: Scallions, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.nameEnglish: Scallions, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.instructionEnglish: Cut the cabbage lengthwise through the stem into quarters. Cut the cores from each piece. Cut each quarter crosswise into 2-inch-wide strips.
steps.instructionGerman: Cut the cabbage lengthwise through the stem into quarters. Cut the cores from each piece. Cut each quarter crosswise into 2-inch-wide strips.

steps.instructionEnglish: Place the cabbage in a large bowl and sprinkle with the salt. Massage the salt into the cabbage until it starts to soften. Add enough water to cover the cabbage. Put a plate on top and weigh it down. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours.
steps.instructionGerman: Place the cabbage in a large bowl and sprinkle with the salt. Massage the salt into the cabbage until it starts to soften. Add enough water to cover the cabbage. Put a plate on top and weigh it down. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours.

steps.instructionEnglish: Rinse the cabbage under cold water 3 times. Set aside to drain in a colander.
steps.instructionGerman: Rinse the cabbage under cold water 3 times. Set aside to drain in a colander.

steps.instructionEnglish: Make the spice paste: Rinse and dry the bowl. Add garlic, ginger, sugar, and fish sauce/shrimp paste/water and stir into a smooth paste. Stir in the gochugaru.
steps.instructionGerman: Make the spice paste: Rinse and dry the bowl. Add garlic, ginger, sugar, and fish sauce/shrimp paste/water and stir into a smooth paste. Stir in the gochugaru.

steps.instructionEnglish: Combine the vegetables and spice paste. Gently squeeze any remaining water from the cabbage and add it to the spice paste. Add the radish and scallions.
steps.instructionGerman: Combine the vegetables and spice paste. Gently squeeze any remaining water from the cabbage and add it to the spice paste. Add the radish and scallions.

steps.instructionEnglish: Mix thoroughly. Using your hands, work the paste into the vegetables until they are thoroughly coated.
steps.instructionGerman: Mix thoroughly. Using your hands, work the paste into the vegetables until they are thoroughly coated.

steps.instructionEnglish: Pack the kimchi into a 1-quart jar. Press down until the brine rises to cover the vegetables, leaving at least 1 inch of space at the top. Seal the jar.
steps.instructionGerman: Pack the kimchi into a 1-quart jar. Press down until the brine rises to cover the vegetables, leaving at least 1 inch of space at the top. Seal the jar.

steps.instructionGerman: Let it ferment for 1 to 5 days at cool room temperature, out of direct sunlight. Place a bowl or plate under the jar to catch overflow.

steps.instructionGerman: Check daily, opening the jar and pressing down on the vegetables to keep them submerged. Taste periodically. When ripe enough, transfer to the refrigerator.

title: Claire Ptak's egg-yolk chocolate chip cookies (Variation)

ingredients.nameGerman: Dark chocolate chips or broken-up bar of your favourite chocolate
ingredients.nameEnglish: Dark chocolate chips or broken-up bar of your favourite chocolate

steps.instructionEnglish: Line a small baking tray or baking tin (one that will fit inside your freezer) with parchment paper.
steps.instructionGerman: Line a small baking tray or baking tin (one that will fit inside your freezer) with parchment paper.

steps.instructionEnglish: When ready to bake, preheat your oven to 160C fan/gas mark 4. steps.instructionGerman: When ready to bake, preheat your oven to 160C fan/gas mark 4. steps.instructionGerman: Bake for 12 minutes, until the centre of each cookie is slightly soft and underbaked but the edges are crispy and golden. Remove from the oven and allow to cool on the tray for 10 minutes before serving.

steps.instructionEnglish: In a large bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt.
steps.instructionGerman: In a large bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt.

steps.instructionEnglish: Fill muffin cups three-quarters full. Bake until tops are lightly browned and spring back when pressed gently.
steps.instructionGerman: Fill muffin cups three-quarters full. Bake until tops are lightly browned and spring back when pressed gently.

notes:
The basic muffin invites creative variation! Try different combinations of dried fruit, berries, nuts and chocolate chips, or simply enjoy the plain muffin fresh from the oven with your favourite jam. Since the sugar and fat content is lower than cake muffins are best served fresh and warm - uneaten muffins should be frozen on the same day if possible. In this version of the basic muffin the natural acidity of yogurt reacts with soda bicarbonate to produce a light texture. As with all muffin recipes, the sugar can be adjusted to suit your taste. For best results, please read the essential muffin-making tips on pages 7-10 before you begin.

*With self-raising flour, omit baking powder; do not omit bicarbonate of soda.

Berry Muffins: Add 4 oz (110 g) berries, folding them into the final batter. Chop large berries. Do not thaw frozen berries; bake an extra 3-4 minutes. (For other berry muffins, see pages 20, 36, 44, 50 and 58.)

Chocolate Chip Muffins: Add 3 oz (85 g) plain chocolate chips.

Dried Fruit Muffins: Many varieties of dried fruit are now available such as cranberry and tropical fruit. Use about 4 oz (110 g).

Note: For a milk-only version of the Basic Muffin, use 3 teaspoons (15 ml) baking powder and 8 fl oz (240 ml) milk; omit soda bicarbonate and yogurt. If using self-raising flour for this version, reduce baking powder to 1 teaspoon (5 ml).

Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated.
Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled.
Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic.
Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese.

Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm.

title: Coffee and Walnut Cake

steps.instructionEnglish: Preheat the oven to 160°C (325°F) for fan ovens or 180°C (350°F) for conventional ovens (Gas Mark 4). Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature. Prepare 2 sandwich cake tins by greasing and lining them with non-stick baking paper. Beat the softened butter for 1 minute in a large bowl with an electric whisk until it is light and fluffy. In a coffee plunger, pour the boiling water over the ground coffee and allow it to infuse for 2 minutes. Plunge and pour the concentrated espresso into a small jug.
steps.instructionGerman: Preheat the oven to 160°C (325°F) for fan ovens or 180°C (350°F) for conventional ovens (Gas Mark 4). Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature. Prepare 2 sandwich cake tins by greasing and lining them with non-stick baking paper. Beat the softened butter for 1 minute in a large bowl with an electric whisk until it is light and fluffy. In a coffee plunger, pour the boiling water over the ground coffee and allow it to infuse for 2 minutes. Plunge and pour the concentrated espresso into a small jug.
steps.tip: Have all the ingredients at room temperature.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add the sugar, eggs, sieved flour and baking powder, the prepared espresso, and vanilla extract to the butter in the bowl. Mix together for 5 minutes until the mixture is light and fluffy. Gently fold in the chopped walnuts. The mixture should drop easily from a spoon.
steps.instructionGerman: Add the sugar, eggs, sieved flour and baking powder, the prepared espresso, and vanilla extract to the butter in the bowl. Mix together for 5 minutes until the mixture is light and fluffy. Gently fold in the chopped walnuts. The mixture should drop easily from a spoon.
steps.tip: The mixture should drop easily from a spoon.

steps.instructionEnglish: Divide the mixture evenly between the 2 prepared tins and bake for 30 minutes (for a 6-inch cake) until risen and light golden in colour. To check for doneness, insert a skewer into the centre of the baked cake; it should come out clean.
steps.instructionGerman: Divide the mixture evenly between the 2 prepared tins and bake for 30 minutes (for a 6-inch cake) until risen and light golden in colour. To check for doneness, insert a skewer into the centre of the baked cake; it should come out clean.
steps.tip: A skewer inserted into the centre of the baked cake should come out clean.

notes:
To store: This cake is best served and eaten fresh but will keep up to 4 days once covered and decorated or wrapped in greaseproof paper and kept in an airtight container. If frozen, allow to defrost overnight.
To serve: When you are ready to decorate this cake, simply sandwich the halves together with espresso buttercream.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bring beef to room temperature for 1 hour. Rub with mustard powder, crushed garlic, sea salt, cracked black pepper, and olive oil.
steps.instructionGerman: Bring beef to room temperature for 1 hour. Rub with mustard powder, crushed garlic, sea salt, cracked black pepper, and olive oil.
steps.tip: Never roast cold meat directly from the fridge.

steps.instructionEnglish: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Roast beef for 20 minutes to sear, then reduce to 170°C (340°F) and roast 15 minutes per 500g for medium-rare.
steps.instructionGerman: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Roast beef for 20 minutes to sear, then reduce to 170°C (340°F) and roast 15 minutes per 500g for medium-rare.

steps.instructionEnglish: Parboil potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes. Drain, shake vigorously in the colander to rough up the edges, and roast in smoking hot beef dripping for 45 minutes until ultra-crispy.
steps.instructionGerman: Parboil potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes. Drain, shake vigorously in the colander to rough up the edges, and roast in smoking hot beef dripping for 45 minutes until ultra-crispy.
steps.tip: Fluffing the edges in the colander creates maximum crunchy glass-like crust.

steps.instructionEnglish: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, and salt until completely smooth. Let batter rest at room temperature. Pour a dash of oil into a 12-hole muffin tin and heat until smoking at 220°C. Pour in batter and bake for 22 minutes without opening the oven door.
steps.instructionGerman: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, and salt until completely smooth. Let batter rest at room temperature. Pour a dash of oil into a 12-hole muffin tin and heat until smoking at 220°C. Pour in batter and bake for 22 minutes without opening the oven door.

steps.instructionEnglish: Deglaze roasting pan juices with red wine, beef stock, and a sprig of thyme. Simmer down into a glossy, rich gravy.
steps.instructionGerman: Deglaze roasting pan juices with red wine, beef stock, and a sprig of thyme. Simmer down into a glossy, rich gravy.

notes: A traditional Sunday staple. Always rest the beef wrapped in foil for at least 20 minutes before carving.

title: Handmade Cheese Egg Noodles with Crispy Caramelized Onions

steps.instructionEnglish: Beat flour, eggs, sparkling water, and salt with a wooden spoon until bubbles form and the dough stretches viscously.
steps.instructionGerman: Beat flour, eggs, sparkling water, and salt with a wooden spoon until bubbles form and the dough stretches viscously.
steps.tip: Beat vigorously until air pockets form in the dough.

steps.instructionEnglish: Caramelize onion rings slowly in butter with a pinch of paprika and salt until deeply golden brown and crisp.
steps.instructionGerman: Caramelize onion rings slowly in butter with a pinch of paprika and salt until deeply golden brown and crisp.

steps.instructionEnglish: Drop noodles into boiling salted water in batches. When they float to the top (about 1-2 mins), lift out with a slotted spoon.
steps.instructionGerman: Drop noodles into boiling salted water in batches. When they float to the top (about 1-2 mins), lift out with a slotted spoon.

steps.instructionEnglish: Layer steaming hot noodles in a warm baking dish alternately with grated Alpine and Emmental cheeses. Top with crispy onions and freshly snipped chives. Serve immediately with long strings of melted cheese!
steps.instructionGerman: Layer steaming hot noodles in a warm baking dish alternately with grated Alpine and Emmental cheeses. Top with crispy onions and freshly snipped chives.
steps.tip: Mix sharp aged cheese for flavor and Emmental for glorious stretch.

notes: Authentic handmade comfort food. Best served piping hot with a crisp side salad.

title: Classic Victoria Sponge Cake

steps.instructionEnglish: Cream softened butter and caster sugar together until pale, fluffy, and light as air.
steps.instructionGerman: Cream softened butter and caster sugar together until pale, fluffy, and light as air.

steps.instructionEnglish: Gradually add beaten eggs, one at a time, along with vanilla extract and a spoonful of flour to prevent curdling.
steps.instructionGerman: Gradually add beaten eggs, one at a time, along with vanilla extract and a spoonful of flour to prevent curdling.

steps.instructionEnglish: Fold in the sifted flour with a metal spoon until just combined. Divide evenly between two lined 20cm (8-inch) cake tins.
steps.instructionGerman: Fold in the sifted flour with a metal spoon until just combined. Divide evenly between two lined 20cm (8-inch) cake tins.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 20-25 minutes until golden and the sponges spring back when lightly touched.
steps.instructionGerman: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 20-25 minutes until golden and the sponges spring back when lightly touched.
steps.tip: Let cool completely on a wire rack before assembling.

steps.instructionEnglish: Spread generous strawberry jam over one sponge, top with freshly whipped cream, sandwich with the second sponge, and dust with icing sugar.
steps.instructionGerman: Spread generous strawberry jam over one sponge, top with freshly whipped cream, sandwich with the second sponge, and dust with icing sugar.

notes: The quintessential afternoon tea cake named after Queen Victoria. Perfect alongside a pot of hot tea.

title: Authentic Black Forest Cherry Torte

steps.instructionEnglish: Whip egg whites with half the sugar until stiff peaks form. Beat yolks with remaining sugar, then fold whites and sifted cocoa flour mixture together.
steps.instructionGerman: Whip egg whites with half the sugar until stiff peaks form. Beat yolks with remaining sugar, then fold whites and sifted cocoa flour mixture together.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bake sponge at 175°C (350°F) for 30-35 minutes. Once cooled, slice horizontally into three even cake discs.
steps.instructionGerman: Bake sponge at 175°C (350°F) for 30-35 minutes. Once cooled, slice horizontally into three even cake discs.

steps.instructionEnglish: Simmer cherries with starch and 2 tbsp cherry brandy until thickened. Cool completely.
steps.instructionGerman: Simmer cherries with starch and 2 tbsp cherry brandy until thickened. Cool completely.

steps.instructionEnglish: Drizzle each cake layer generously with cherry brandy. Layer cake disc, thickened sour cherries, fresh whipped cream, repeat for 2nd layer.
steps.instructionGerman: Drizzle each cake layer generously with cherry brandy. Layer cake disc, thickened sour cherries, fresh whipped cream, repeat for 2nd layer.

steps.instructionEnglish: Frost the entire cake with whipped cream, coat sides with chocolate curls, and pipe 12 cream rosettes topped with whole cherries.
steps.instructionGerman: Frost the entire cake with whipped cream, coat sides with chocolate curls, and pipe 12 cream rosettes topped with whole cherries.

notes: Authentic Black Forest cake made with rich chocolate layers, sour cherries, and fragrant cherry brandy.

title: Easy Indian Mint Sauce (Restaurant Style Pudina Chutney)

ingredients.name: Black Salt (Kala Namak) or Sea Salt

steps.instructionEnglish: Thoroughly wash the fresh mint and coriander leaves in cold water, discarding any tough stems. Drain well.
steps.instructionGerman: Thoroughly wash the fresh mint and coriander leaves in cold water, discarding any tough stems. Drain well.
steps.tip: Discard thick mint stems as they can introduce bitterness to the chutney.

steps.instructionEnglish: In a blender jar, add the washed mint, coriander, green chillies, garlic, ginger, roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, salt, sugar, and fresh lemon juice.
steps.instructionGerman: In a blender jar, add the washed mint, coriander, green chillies, garlic, ginger, roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, salt, sugar, and fresh lemon juice.
steps.tip: Lemon juice prevents the mint and coriander from oxidizing, keeping the sauce vibrant green.

steps.instructionEnglish: Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of water or yogurt. Blend everything together into a smooth, bright green herb paste.
steps.instructionGerman: Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of water or yogurt. Blend everything together into a smooth, bright green herb paste.

steps.instructionEnglish: Transfer the herb paste into a bowl. Gently whisk in the remaining chilled yogurt until velvety and smooth. Chill in refrigerator for 20 minutes before serving with samosas, pakoras, poppadoms, or tandoori grills.
steps.instructionGerman: Transfer the herb paste into a bowl. Gently whisk in the remaining chilled yogurt until velvety and smooth. Chill in refrigerator for 20 minutes before serving.
steps.tip: Whisking yogurt by hand rather than over-blending prevents it from turning watery.

notes: Authentic British-Indian restaurant style mint chutney. For a dairy-free / vegan version, replace the yogurt with 2 tablespoons of cold water and an extra splash of lemon juice.

title: Grandma's Soft & Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

steps.instructionEnglish: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
steps.instructionGerman: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
steps.tip: Parchment paper prevents bottoms from over-browning.

steps.instructionEnglish: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and fine sea salt. Set aside.
steps.instructionGerman: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and fine sea salt. Set aside.

steps.instructionEnglish: In a large mixer bowl, beat softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar on medium speed for 2 minutes until creamy and fluffy. Beat in vanilla extract and eggs one at a time until fully incorporated.
steps.instructionGerman: In a large mixer bowl, beat softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar on medium speed for 2 minutes until creamy and fluffy. Beat in vanilla extract and eggs one at a time until fully incorporated.
steps.tip: Creaming the butter and sugars well creates tender cookie centers.

steps.instructionEnglish: Gradually stir in the flour mixture on low speed until just combined (do not overmix). Fold in the semi-sweet chocolate chips with a spatula.
steps.instructionGerman: Gradually stir in the flour mixture on low speed until just combined. Fold in the semi-sweet chocolate chips with a spatula.
steps.tip: For thicker, bakery-style cookies, chill dough in refrigerator for 30 minutes before baking.

steps.instructionEnglish: Drop rounded scoops (about 1.5 to 2 tablespoons each) onto prepared baking sheets, spaced 5cm (2 inches) apart. Top with extra chocolate chips if desired.
steps.instructionGerman: Drop rounded scoops (about 1.5 to 2 tablespoons each) onto prepared baking sheets, spaced 5cm (2 inches) apart.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden brown and centers are still soft. Sprinkle lightly with flaky sea salt. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Enjoy warm with a glass of cold milk!
steps.instructionGerman: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden brown and centers are still soft. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes.
steps.tip: Take them out when centers still look slightly pale; they will finish setting on the hot baking sheet for that perfect chew.

notes: Grandmother's cherished golden chocolate chip cookies. The combination of brown sugar and pure vanilla extract gives them a rich caramel note and ultra-chewy texture.

title: Grandma's Traditional Apple Strudel

ingredients.name: Tart Baking Apples (Granny Smith or Bramley)

steps.instructionEnglish: Knead flour, warm water, oil, and salt into a silky, smooth dough. Form a ball, brush with oil, cover with a warm bowl, and let rest for 30 minutes.
steps.instructionGerman: Knead flour, warm water, oil, and salt into a silky, smooth dough. Form a ball, brush with oil, cover with a warm bowl, and let rest for 30 minutes.
steps.tip: The dough must rest under a warm bowl to stretch paper-thin without tearing.

steps.instructionEnglish: Peel, core, and thinly slice the apples. Toss with sugar, ground cinnamon, rum raisins, and lemon juice.
steps.instructionGerman: Peel, core, and thinly slice the apples. Toss with sugar, ground cinnamon, rum raisins, and lemon juice.
steps.tip: Use tart, firm baking apples for the best balance of sweetness and texture.

steps.instructionEnglish: Melt 30g butter in a skillet and gently toast the breadcrumbs until golden brown and fragrant.
steps.instructionGerman: Melt 30g butter in a skillet and gently toast the breadcrumbs until golden brown and fragrant.
steps.tip: The breadcrumbs soak up apple juices to keep the bottom pastry crisp.

steps.instructionEnglish: Lay a clean cotton kitchen towel on the table and dust with flour. Roll the dough thinly, then gently stretch using the backs of your hands until translucent (you should be able to read through it).
steps.instructionGerman: Lay a clean cotton kitchen towel on the table and dust with flour. Roll the dough thinly, then gently stretch using the backs of your hands until translucent.
steps.tip: Stretch slowly and evenly from the center outwards.

steps.instructionEnglish: Brush the stretched dough with melted butter. Scatter toasted breadcrumbs over two-thirds of the area, then spread the spiced apple mixture on top.
steps.instructionGerman: Brush the stretched dough with melted butter. Scatter toasted breadcrumbs over two-thirds of the area, then spread the spiced apple mixture on top.

steps.instructionEnglish: Roll up the strudel tightly using the kitchen towel. Transfer seam-side down to a lined baking sheet and brush generously with melted butter.
steps.instructionGerman: Roll up the strudel tightly using the kitchen towel. Transfer seam-side down to a lined baking sheet and brush generously with melted butter.

steps.instructionEnglish: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 35-40 minutes until deeply golden and flaky. Dust with powdered sugar while warm and serve with warm vanilla custard or cream.
steps.instructionGerman: Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 35-40 minutes until deeply golden and flaky. Dust with powdered sugar while warm and serve with warm vanilla custard or cream.
steps.tip: Brush with more melted butter halfway through baking for extra crispness.

notes: Grandmother's secret was soaking the raisins in dark rum overnight and rolling the dough on her vintage cotton tablecloth.

title: Coffee and Walnut Cake

steps.instructionEnglish: Preheat the oven to 160°C (325°F) for fan ovens or 180°C (350°F) for conventional ovens (Gas Mark 4). Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature. Prepare 2 sandwich cake tins by greasing and lining them with non-stick baking paper. Beat the softened butter for 1 minute in a large bowl with an electric whisk until it is light and fluffy. In a coffee plunger, pour the boiling water over the ground coffee and allow it to infuse for 2 minutes. Plunge and pour the concentrated espresso into a small jug.

title: How to make Biltong

ingredients.name: Beef (suitable for biltong, e.g., silverside or topside)
ingredients.nameEnglish: Beef (suitable for biltong, e.g., silverside or topside)

steps.instructionEnglish: Choose 1 kg of raw meat suitable for biltong (e.g., beef silverside or topside). Cut the meat into strips of your desired thickness.

In a bowl, combine 10g ground sea salt, 8g coarse ground coriander seed, and 3g coarse ground black pepper. Rub this spice mixture thoroughly over the meat strips. Add vinegar as desired for flavor. Marinate the meat for 6 to 12 hours, depending on how much vinegar flavor you prefer.
steps.tip: We recommend marinating anywhere for 6 - 12 hours depending on how much vinegar flavor you want.

steps.instructionEnglish: After marinating, prepare the rub spice by combining 6g ground sea salt, 5g coarse ground coriander seed, and 2g coarse ground black pepper. Apply this rub spice evenly over all surfaces of the marinated meat.
Hang the spiced meat strips in a well-ventilated area to dry. Ensure good airflow around each piece.
Allow the biltong to dry for several days until it reaches your desired texture and dryness. Once ready, slice and enjoy your homemade biltong.

notes: This recipe provides a simple guide for making biltong at home. The active preparation time is approximately 30 minutes, followed by a marinating period of 6-12 hours. The drying process (hanging) typically takes several days, depending on environmental conditions and desired dryness. Feel free to adjust spices to your liking. The original source emphasizes choosing quality meat.
